variables.name: jvmVersionInfoAvailable
variables.comment: true if JVM exports the version info including the capabilities

methods.name: public static void print()
methods.comment:
* In case you were wondering this method is called by java -version.
     * Sad that it prints to stderr; would be nicer if default printed on
     * stdout.

methods.name: public static void println()
methods.comment:
* This is the same as print except that it adds an extra line-feed
     * at the end, typically used by the -showversion in the launcher

methods.name: public static void print(PrintStream ps)
methods.comment: * Give a stream, it will print version info on it.

methods.name: public static synchronized int jvmMajorVersion()
methods.comment:
* Returns the major version of the running JVM if it's 1.6 or newer
     * or any RE VM build. It will return 0 if it's an internal 1.5 or
     * 1.4.x build.
     *
     * @since 1.6

methods.name: public static synchronized int jvmMinorVersion()
methods.comment:
* Returns the minor version of the running JVM if it's 1.6 or newer
     * or any RE VM build. It will return 0 if it's an internal 1.5 or
     * 1.4.x build.
     * @since 1.6

methods.name: public static synchronized int jvmMicroVersion()
methods.comment:
* Returns the micro version of the running JVM if it's 1.6 or newer
     * or any RE VM build. It will return 0 if it's an internal 1.5 or
     * 1.4.x build.
     * @since 1.6

methods.name: public static synchronized int jvmUpdateVersion()
methods.comment:
* Returns the update release version of the running JVM if it's
     * a RE build. It will return 0 if it's an internal build.
     * @since 1.6

methods.name: public static synchronized int jvmBuildNumber()
methods.comment:
* Returns the build number of the running JVM if it's a RE build
     * It will return 0 if it's an internal build.
     * @since 1.6

methods.name: private static native boolean getJvmVersionInfo()
methods.comment: Return false if not available which implies an old VM (Tiger or before).
